newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Pikko up 46.15 pct on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Bank Pikko up 46.15 pct on rumours.

text.p: Shares of minor Indonesian bank, Bank Pikko, rose 46.15 percent in active mid-morning trade by on Tuesday on market talk that a business tycoon was expected to acquire a large stake in the firm, brokers said.
Bank Pikko rose 600 rupiah, or 46.15 percent, to 1,900 rupiah with volume approaching 14 million shares shortly before the lunch break.
"We heard that a business tycoon is likely to take a large stake in the firm, but we don't know who he is. The local players are very actively buying the bank," one broker said.
Bank Pikko officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
